Symbol:

Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> qi_2;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined qi_2 (quadlet
indicator) 2 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype IEC68133_IIDC.
The value range for qi_2 shall be:
0x00...0x03 : valid
0x04...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the value of qi_2 shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided by the
application.
Visibility:
protected
